In this case, other high-risk features were still documented, so impact is limited.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a sensation of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts include difficulty breathing but do not mention a sensation of throat closing.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: A sensation of throat closing is a key red-flag symptom for evolving anaphylaxis and impending airway compromise; failing to capture it can understate severity and potentially delay escalation (e.g., epinephrine/EMS prioritization). Although difficulty breathing was noted, throat-tightness specifically signals higher airway risk.
